documents.text: Postmortem for the 3 March checkout outage: the checkout API was down for 47 minutes. Root cause was database connection pool exhaustion after a config change lowered max connections from 100 to 10. Fix: restored the limit and added an alert at 80% pool usage.
Project Falcon design doc: Falcon is the next-generation warehouse robot controller. It replaces the polling loop with an event bus on NATS and targets 5 ms control latency.
On-call runbook: page the secondary engineer if the primary does not acknowledge within 10 minutes. The on-call rotation changes every Monday at 10:00 IST.
Engineering roadmap for Q4: ship the Falcon beta to two pilot warehouses, move CI to self-hosted runners, and retire the legacy inventory service.
Project Falcon budget: the approved budget is USD 2.4M for FY2027, split into USD 1.1M hardware, USD 0.9M engineering headcount and USD 0.4M pilot operations.
Q3 financial results: revenue grew 18% quarter over quarter to USD 12.6M, and gross margin was 41%.
Vendor payment policy: invoices above USD 50,000 need CFO approval and are paid on net-45 terms.
Salary bands for 2027: Senior Software Engineer is INR 38-52 lakh per year; Staff Engineer is INR 55-75 lakh per year.
Performance review calendar: self reviews are due on 15 November, and calibration meetings run from 20 to 28 November.
Board memo, confidential: Acme is in early talks to acquire a small computer-vision startup, code name Heron. Do not share outside the leadership team.
Hiring plan for 2027: add 14 engineers and 3 product managers, and freeze sales hiring until Q2.

Leave policy: employees get 24 days of paid leave per year. Parental leave is 26 weeks for the primary caregiver and 4 weeks for the secondary caregiver. Apply in the HR portal at least 30 days in advance.
Expense policy: meals during business travel are reimbursed up to INR 2,500 per day. Submit receipts within 30 days.
Security policy: every laptop must use full-disk encryption, and production access requires a hardware security key.
